newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Grootvlei shareholders agree to Harmony buy.
newsitem.headline: Grootvlei shareholders agree to Harmony buy.

text.p: Grootvlei Proprietary Mines Ltd said on Thursdsay its shareholders had agreed to a scheme to allow Harmony Gold Mining Co Ltd to buy it out.

The companies said in a statement on Thursday, listings of Grootvlei would be terminated from the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE), the London Stock Exchange (LSE) and NASDAQ at the close of business on Friday.
In terms of the scheme, announced in April, Harmony will issue about 3.10 million shares in exchange for the cancellation of all the issued Grootvlei shares other than those held by Harmony.
The listing of the new Harmony shares in terms of the scheme will start on the JSE, LSE and NASDAQ on Monday, June 9.
